title: citysample-carla: running Epic's City Sample as a CARLA simulator
description:
Tooling that runs Epic Games' City Sample (Unreal Engine 5.8, both Small_City_LVL and Big_City_LVL) as a CARLA 1.0 driving simulator, and extracts the city's road network as multi-lane ASAM OpenDRIVE so it can be driven in any CARLA.

Part A exports Epic's ZoneGraph through a small Unreal plugin and converts it to multi-lane OpenDRIVE across both Small_City_LVL (2,981 roads including 236 multi-lane roads, 172 junctions, 4,672 spawn points, 23,536 lane-change waypoints) and Big_City_LVL (21,712 roads including 1,312 multi-lane roads, 1,236 junctions, 33,590 spawn points, 158,358 lane-change waypoints), with road-class speed limits, traffic lights, curbside stop signs, yield signs, US MUTCD speed-limit signs, and reference-line crosswalks (0.00 m median error). Part B hosts the City Sample levels directly as a CARLA 1.0 server, fixing collision channels, FastGeoStreaming and HLOD camera/LiDAR semantic segmentation (enabled by default, 0.0%-0.4% settled unlabeled with 0.00% out-of-range labels from Run 1), URayTracer and ego-attached ray-cast sensors, measured ZoneGraph pedestrian navmeshes (7,846 and 59,384 pedestrian lanes forming single connected islands), and a two-way Mass ECS traffic and crowd bridge that centers on the hero vehicle, exports CARLA actors as Mass obstacles so ambient traffic brakes for them, and coexists with CARLA's Traffic Manager. Also verified with CARLA 1.0's NVIDIA NuRec (3DGUT / NRE 26.04) photorealistic neural rendering pipeline.

Thirteen reproducible CARLA defects found during the work are documented, with twelve filed upstream.

No Epic Games content, and no data derived from it, is included: the tools regenerate everything from the user's own City Sample installation.
